sloka: यावत् तु निर्यतः तस्य रजो रूपम् अदृश्यत ।न एव इक्ष्वाकु वरः तावत् सम्जहार आत्म चक्षुषी ॥२-४२-१॥
transliteration: yāvat tu niryataḥ tasya rajo rūpam adṛśyata ।na eva ikṣvāku varaḥ tāvat samjahāra ātma cakṣuṣī ॥2-42-1॥

translations.english: As long as the dust raised by the wheels of the chariot of Rama (who was departing to the forest) was visible, Dasaratha, the best of the Ikshvakus, could not withdraw his eyes (from Rama).
